title: Add Divider
content: Create divider component for separating content sections. Simple divider: h-px bg-gray-200 w-full. With label: flex items-center with border lines on each side. Label style: px-4 text-sm text-gray-500 whitespace-nowrap. Line segments: flex-1 h-px bg-gray-200. Vertical divider: w-px h-full bg-gray-200 for side-by-side content. Variants: solid (default), dashed (border-dashed), dotted. Spacing: my-4 or my-8 for vertical spacing. With icon: icon centered instead of text.

variants.simple: Create horizontal dividers with optional labels or icons.
variants.detailed: Create divider component for separating content sections. Simple divider: h-px bg-gray-200 w-full. With label: flex items-center with border lines on each side. Label style: px-4 text-sm text-gray-500 whitespace-nowrap. Line segments: flex-1 h-px bg-gray-200. Vertical divider: w-px h-full bg-gray-200 for side-by-side content. Variants: solid (default), dashed (border-dashed), dotted. Spacing: my-4 or my-8 for vertical spacing. With icon: icon centered instead of text.
variants.advanced: Create flexible divider component with multiple variants. Horizontal divider base: relative flex items-center w-full my-6. Line only: single div h-px bg-gray-200. With centered content: lines as flex-1 h-px bg-gray-200 on each side, content (text/icon) px-4 flex-shrink-0. Content styling: text-sm font-medium text-gray-500 uppercase tracking-wider (for section headers) or normal case. Alignment: center (default), left, right - adjust flex proportions. Vertical divider: w-px self-stretch bg-gray-200 mx-4 for inline separation. Variants: solid (bg-gray-200), dashed (border-l border-dashed), dotted (border-l border-dotted), gradient (bg-gradient-to-r from-transparent via-gray-200 to-transparent). Colors: light (gray-200), medium (gray-300), dark (gray-400), or semantic colors. Thickness: thin (h-px), medium (h-0.5), thick (h-1). Spacing: tight (my-2), normal (my-4), loose (my-8). With icon: replace text content with icon component (ArrowDown, Plus, Star). Decorative: ornamental divider with SVG pattern or icon sequence. Accessibility: role="separator" for semantic meaning, aria-orientation. Props: orientation (horizontal/vertical), variant, color, thickness, spacing, children (label content), align, decorative (boolean for aria-hidden).
